project.name: Nanashi installation website
project.productType: Product marketing, feature discovery and native installation

must: Preserve Nanashi Cold Glass identity and upstream attribution
No health data or analytics on website
Minimum 44px control targets; keyboard and reduced motion support
Only published and validated artifacts can become download links
21st-derived visual patterns with visible exact source links

decisions.decision: Use static CSS adaptations of three retrieved 21st components, sharing the native app palette. No motion library required.
decisions.reason: Retain cold-glass character with small runtime and stable keyboard interactions.

decisions.decision: Prioritize a direct install link for returning iPhone users with an explicit SideStore or AltStore choice; separate initial setup from updates. Detect the phone platform with a manual override, keep technical options collapsed, and hand desktop visitors to a QR plus a copyable link.
decisions.reason: The user found installation too complicated. Reuse the existing 21st-derived glass surfaces and controls without an onboarding library or claims that the browser can detect installation success.
decisions.grounding: Reviewed search results Minimal Welcome Onboarding 29517, Onboarding Checklist 5587 and Onboarding Steps with Progress 29458. No code was retrieved or incorporated from these results; the installed GlassPanel, GlassLink and PlatformTabs primitives remain the component sources.

decisions.decision: Keep SideStore setup on a dedicated French Nanashi page with seven revisitable stages: computer, USB connection, SideStore installation, iPhone preparation, first renewal, Nanashi installation and renewal automation. Provide direct official downloads and browser-local user confirmations.
decisions.reason: The user rejects external documentation handoffs; preserve existing 21st-derived glass primitives and make each action explicit without claiming native installation detection.

decisions.decision: Add a separate five-stage Nanashi Installer guide: computer bootstrap, iPhone authorization, local connection, Nanashi installation and renewal verification. Offer published installer packages only after validation; retain the SideStore path. The installer QR opens https://nanashi-mk.vercel.app/installation-nanashi?step=iphone#installation-etape at the second stage.
decisions.reason: Distinguish AltStore bootstrap from actual Nanashi installation. Keep native account entry, confirmations and renewal checks explicit, preserve existing apps, and avoid claims of unattended or permanent Apple signing. The shared link selects a stage without transferring or confirming browser-local progress.

decisions.decision: Center the oversized WHOOP/no-WHOOP-membership proposition above a broad layered product studio, then feature exploration, data ownership, precise source compatibility and installation. Preserve Cold Glass / Harbor Blue and native type.
decisions.reason: Make the hardware-reuse benefit explicit and memorable while showing the actual app. No sales volume, testimonials, product price or paid checkout is invented.

decisions.decision: Default fresh iPhone visits to first installation; remember only an explicitly selected manager/path in sessionStorage. Keep direct manager links for returning visitors.
decisions.reason: Do not silently assume first-time visitors already have SideStore; tolerate blocked/invalid storage.
